description: Search the Wyoming Statutes BY TOPIC or keyword rather than citation — "landlord security deposit", "concealed firearm permit", "murder penalty". Full-text search over the statutory body text across all titles (except Title 97, the Constitution). Returns matching citations and headings; call wy_statute with a citation for the full text. Keyless.

query.description: Topic or keywords, e.g. "landlord security deposit".

name: wy_search
